design: The old cache already shares repeated uniform cells. Primitive material keys and tree references replace boxed keys and map entries; retained geometry is unchanged.

Arrays grow at load at most one half. Entry budget equals the geometry-cell count, bounded by the existing 131,072-leaf admission cap. Each final array has at most 262,144 slots. Old/new arrays coexist during growth.
All admitted materials remain cached. Model instances retain their separate cache, bounded by 512 dependencies. Fractional geometry bypasses uniform pooling.
Rehash and long collision scans check cancellation every 1,024 steps. Failed growth leaves the old table intact. Cache state does not survive preparation.

cpu_probe.method: Exact parent Engine source compiled separately against unchanged dependency classes. Separate JVMs, parent first, three warmups then 20 measured runs per fixture. Current-thread allocation counter; ordered Protocol.CellState bytes hashed outside timing. No competing assigned Maven/native process; shared VPS.
cpu_probe.fixtures: 100,000 cells for one repeated material, all-unique LED materials or 4,096 repeated LED materials. Mixed uses 10,000 cells with 10% two-leaf fractional geometry. Bounds 128x8x128, empty detached source.
cpu_probe.limits: Preparation CPU/allocation only; no commit, save, rendering, network, peak-memory or full city/maximum qualification. An earlier exploratory 100,000-cell mixed case took parent median 9,033.051 ms. Final mixed size is bounded at 10,000 cells; it is not an acceptance fixture.

live_heap_probe.method: 100,000 cells and 4,096 materials. Real WorldVoxels geometry and actual StructureEngine commit/undo records remain alive. Synthetic authority publishes geometry without persistence, rendering or networking. One warmup then three post-GC retained heap estimates per mode. Actual undo checked after each sample. This is not peak memory or 20-run memory qualification.
live_heap_probe.interpretation: Parent and primitive retain 4,096 after-image trees. Primitive median 11,246,680 versus parent 11,217,400 bytes differs by 29,280 bytes in these noisy post-GC estimates. No retained-memory reduction claimed. Rejected cap increases retained objects and heap.
